channel.title: Covering Katy News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Covering Katy News (coveringkaty.com)

item.title: Nearly 200 Katy ISD Student-Athletes Earn Academic All-State Honors in Fall Sports
item.description: Nearly 200 Katy ISD student-athletes have earned spots on the Texas High School Coaches Association Academic fall sports All-State teams, demonstrating excellence in both academics and athletics.

item.title: Suspect sought after Hanukkah decorations vandalized at Katy restaurant
item.description: The Harris County Sheriff's Office is seeking the public's help in identifying a suspect who vandalized Hanukkah decorations at a Katy restaurant.

item.title: Mark Rubal announces bid for Fort Bend County District Attorney in 2026 Republican primary
item.description: Mark Rubal, a veteran trial attorney with 35 years of legal experience, has announced his candidacy for the Republican nomination for Fort Bend County District Attorney.

item.title: Dick's Sporting Goods, Havertys Furniture Coming to Grand at Aliana
item.description: The Grand at Aliana shopping center will add two major national retailers with construction beginning this week on an 87,000-square-foot building for Dick's Sporting Goods and Havertys Furniture, according to developer NewQuest.

item.title: Pittsburgh's Vocelli Pizza opening Katy location with halal menu
item.description: A Pittsburgh-based pizzeria will open a Katy location next year with a halal menu designed to appeal to Houston's diverse community.

item.title: Family of 4 struck by wrong-way driver on Grand Parkway; mother, father, daughter killed
item.description: Three people, including a 5-year-old girl, are dead after a wrong-way driver struck a family of four on Grand Parkway near FM 1464 early Saturday morning. A 3-year-old boy remains hospitalized.

item.title: Katy Man admits sexually abusing a child sentenced to 10 years
item.description: A 41-year old Katy man was sentenced to 10 years in prison for sexually abusing a child. He also served as a police officer for several area departments.

item.title: Two Women File for Katy City Council Ward A Special Election to Replace Dan Smith
item.description: Two candidates will face off in the Jan. 31 special election to the Ward A seat on the Katy City Council being vacated by Dan Smith, who is resigning to run for Waller County Pct. 4 commissioner.

item.title: Community rallies around 3-year-old boy orphaned in Grand Parkway wrong-way crash
item.description: A community fundraising campaign has raised more than $78,000 as of Wednesday morning for the 3-year-old survivor of a wrong-way crash that killed three members of his family on the Grand Parkway.

item.title: Fuzzy's Taco Shop opens on Mason Road in Katy
item.description: Taco lovers have a new spot to grab brisket tacos and frozen margaritas with the opening of Fuzzy's Taco Shop on Mason Road.
